s0-context.title: Load baseline context
s0-context.imperative: Read docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, and the engine config. Note the enabled rigor checkpoints, authority rules, and rework cap for this run, then attest c1.

postconditions.statement: orchestrator context + glossary + engine config loaded

s1-understand.title: Understand the ask
s1-understand.imperative: Dispatch the Interrogator (a survey) to resolve the request; consolidate to a problem statement. If understand.done is an enabled checkpoint, the human confirms it (user-decision).

s2-plan.title: Plan the change
s2-plan.imperative: Read the recorded architecture (Cartographer packets) to frame the bounded problem, then author the gate plan into <work-id>-execute (the frozen method handed to the Pilot). Get the human to approve the plan.

postconditions.statement: execute gate plan authored (one bounded issue; no 40-gate sprawl)

s3-execute.title: Execute the plan
s3-execute.imperative: Hand the frozen plan to the Pilot, which drives the Crew gate by gate. Do not touch code. A structural surprise bubbles up as a signal; if the plan is proven wrong, end the run and re-issue (one shot).

postconditions.statement: every execute gate closed with integrated evidence

s4-cleanup.title: Clean up
s4-cleanup.imperative: Reconcile implemented changes into the Cartographer map (architecture write-back), drain triage_candidates to Triage, archive the package. If run.accept is enabled, the human accepts the run.

postconditions.statement: map reconciled; triage candidates routed; package archived
